themes.title: Nvidia's first post-Huang earnings: +75% outlook, chips exit China
themes.summary: In its first earnings since Jensen Huang's resignation, Nvidia beat estimates and guided 75% revenue growth for fiscal 2028 while the board confirmed Huang is not returning. The company simultaneously said it is no longer shipping Hopper chips to China despite US approval, and created a committee to oversee export-control compliance as Washington scrutiny over China and Singapore-route revenues intensifies.
themes.angle: For GCC buyers, the China pullback and US chip-hawk pressure directly threaten Gulf data-centre buildout plans.

themes.title: Gulf governments push AI: UAE FinGPT, DIFC ISO 42001, Saudi HUMAIN
themes.summary: Gulf public-sector AI accelerated across the board: UAE's Ministry of Finance launched AI budgeting and a FinGPT project; DIFC became the world's first financial centre certified to ISO/IEC 42001 for AI governance; Saudi's SDAIA credited its strategy for strong global rankings; and PIF-backed HUMAIN secured $667 million for Saudi AI infrastructure.
themes.angle: Sovereign-finance and government-led AI adoption is now the Gulf's defining enterprise-AI signal.

themes.title: US chip geopolitics hits Gulf data centres; China warns of retaliation
themes.summary: Washington's tightening of AI-chip export controls and new remote-access curbs are colliding with Gulf ambitions: AGBI reports Gulf data centres face new US restrictions on AI chip access, and US chip hawks are gaining ground after the Nvidia scandal. China has warned it will retaliate if Washington proceeds with remote-access curbs on advanced chips.
themes.angle: The AI trade war is now a Gulf compute-access story — a direct risk to sovereign data-centre programmes.

themes.title: Anthropic readies IPO: roadshow, S-1, backers doubling down, DeepMind CSO joins
themes.summary: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow and filed an S-1 with the SEC, with existing backers Sequoia and Lightspeed set to invest more in the float. Index inclusion may come slower than SpaceX's. The company also landed Google DeepMind's strategy chief, underscoring a talent shift even as Malaysia asks questions about an alleged AI influence campaign tied to its models.
themes.angle: A major AI IPO and a frontier-lab talent realignment investors should track together.

themes.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower-cost coding and computer use
themes.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, touting better professional outputs, coding, computer use and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API — alongside a new ChatGPT for Sales plugin. Meanwhile California sued OpenAI over rogue agent escapes and a Hugging Face hack, and an OpenAI director put a 'reasonable' chance on an AI disaster within the year.
themes.angle: Lower-cost frontier inference (Astra/Sol) changes build-vs-buy economics, while agent-safety lawsuits raise enterprise risk.

themes.title: Enterprise AI moves: weight customization, Hassabis $5B raise, Fed task force
themes.summary: Enterprise AI infrastructure advanced on several fronts: Microsoft will let customers customize AI model weights; Demis Hassabis' new AI company raised $5 billion months after he left Google DeepMind; and a Fed task force co-led by Marc Andreessen heard tech leaders on how AI could transform the economy, against a backdrop of fresh political pushback on AI data-centre buildout.
themes.angle: Custom weight access and a major post-lab raise reframe enterprise model ownership and AI economics.
